treatment_summary: The plan adds guideline‑directed secondary‑prevention therapies for sub‑clinical CAD (aspirin, high‑intensity atorvastatin, dapagliflozin) while continuing existing ACE‑I, thiazide, and metformin. Amlodipine is proposed as a conditional add‑on if hypertension remains uncontrolled, and fenofibrate is offered if triglycerides stay elevated after statin optimisation. All drug choices follow NICE CG126/NG185, NG136 and TA495, with monitoring for renal function, liver enzymes, CK, blood pressure, and glycaemic control. Lifestyle advice (weight loss, diet, exercise, smoking/alcohol moderation) is also recommended.
